quote: a benchmark in which coding agents build a complete LLM serving system for a given model, GPU allocation, and workload, and decide how much workload it serves
note: [c-object-apparatus] 被评测的东西是「整套服务系统 + 服务多少负载」，不是一段代码

quote: Starting from a minimal Transformers server, agents plan experiments and revise their systems within a fixed development budget.
note: [c-object-apparatus] 起点被压到最小（一个朴素 Transformers 服务器），预算固定

quote: We curated 54 tasks from merged pull requests with measurable performance improvements.
note: [c-object-apparatus] 小一级的尺度：54 个已合并 PR 的优化补丁

quote: SWE-Serve provides 53 repository-grounded tasks derived from recent production changes to SGLang, spanning six inference engineering families.
note: [c-object-apparatus] 再小一级：53 个仓库级生产变更任务

quote: a suite of 250 carefully selected PyTorch ML workloads
note: [c-object-apparatus] 最小一级：250 个单 kernel 负载

quote: Among the 36 pull requests we study
note: [c-object-apparatus] 另一支：36 个跨 Megatron-LM / vLLM / verl 的基础设施 PR

quote: Oversimplified workloads
note: [c-three-gaps] 缺口一：负载被简化成独立请求或固定 prefill/decode 场景

quote: Speedup-only objectives
note: [c-three-gaps] 缺口二：只比加速比，忽略延迟要求与 GPU 成本，且负载固定

quote: Correctness-only validation
note: [c-three-gaps] 缺口三：只对参考实现或测试集查正确性

quote: ServerBench replays recorded coding-agent sessions
note: [c-three-gaps] 堵法一：回放真实 coding-agent 会话（含多轮、共享前缀、并行子 agent 分支、轮间延迟）

quote: latency-qualified token value per dollar of GPU cost
note: [c-three-gaps] 堵法二：目标改成「每美元 GPU 成本换来的、满足延迟档位的 token 价值」

quote: Optimizations such as speculative decoding, state reuse, and custom scheduling introduce execution paths that short or isolated tests rarely exercise.
note: [c-three-gaps] 堵法三：这些优化引入的执行路径，短测试或隔离测试很少覆盖到

quote: Only verified systems receive a score.
note: [c-three-gaps] 未通过验证的系统不计分

quote: Sonnet 5.5 improves its server before raising concurrency, then limits load when additional sessions worsen TPOT
note: [c-objective-behavior] 高价值设计的做法：先提升服务能力再提并发，TPOT 恶化时收敛负载

quote: while keeping time to first token (TTFT) and time per output token (TPOT) within targets
note: [c-objective-behavior] 目标里同时含 TTFT 与 TPOT 两个延迟档位

quote: high-value designs coordinate capacity improvements with load selection
note: [c-objective-behavior] 作者自己的归纳：高价值设计协调「容量提升」与「负载选择」

quote: decide how much workload it serves
note: [c-objective-behavior] 负载量是 agent 的决策变量，这改变了优化问题的形状

quote: 22 of 33 runs yield verified systems, and 13 exceed the strongest baseline
note: [c-delivery-uneven] 33 次运行里 22 次通过验证，只有 13 次超过最强基线

quote: Six models deliver verified systems on all three deployments, but only three exceed the strongest reference on all three.
note: [c-delivery-uneven] 六个模型三档全过验证，只有三个三档全超基线

quote: GPT 6.1 Sol achieves 2.84 on Qwen3.5 9B, while its Qwen3.8 27B INT4 system scores 0.98 against a reference of 1.47
note: [c-delivery-uneven] 同一 agent 跨档位反号：一档 2.84，另一档 0.98 低于参考的 1.47

quote: Performance remains uneven across agents.
note: [c-delivery-uneven] 作者自己的措辞：交付并不均匀

quote: still fall below a simple hyperparameter search under the same time budget
note: [c-delivery-uneven] 同等时间预算下，agent 还输给简单超参搜索

quote: only 5 of the 33 entries have recorded checks of natural stopping on the submitted system under load or long context
note: [c-verification-gap] 33 个提交里只有 5 个记录了「负载/长上下文下自然停止」的检查

quote: Related symptoms precede submission in 8 of 11 not-passed runs
note: [c-verification-gap] 11 次未通过里 8 次在提交前就已有相关症状

quote: Its submitted policy leaves a range of permitted prompt lengths unable to enter execution even after other requests finish
note: [c-verification-gap] 案例：准入策略让一段允许的提示长度永远进不了执行，短测试查不出

quote: The isolated test misses prefix reuse across requests.
note: [c-verification-gap] 案例：隔离测试漏掉跨请求的前缀复用崩溃

quote: Local Correctness Does Not Ensure Production Correctness
note: [c-verification-gap] 另一条线独立给出同一结论：局部正确不等于生产正确

quote: a post-run review inspects code and recorded actions for prohibited shortcuts
note: [c-verification-gap] 验证之外还有事后评审，查被禁止的捷径

quote: A random-text probe leads one agent to reject an optimization; workload replies reveal its benefit and lead another to adopt it
note: [c-feedback-locality] 随机文本探针让一个 agent 拒绝了某优化，真实负载回复让另一个 agent 采纳了它

quote: Interpreting feedback in workload context guides optimization.
note: [c-feedback-locality] 作者归纳：反馈必须放在负载语境里解读

quote: workload-selected draft length 7 outperforms synthetic-selected length 3
note: [c-feedback-locality] 同一系统上，按负载选的草稿长度胜过按合成数据选的

quote: they overwhelmingly converge on a single inference framework
note: [c-feedback-locality] 反面：agent 会过早收敛到单一框架，说明它没在用负载反馈扩大搜索

quote: strawman baselines manufacture speedups, absolute times do not transfer across machines, saturated tasks nullify comparisons, and infrastructure defects impersonate science
note: [c-measurement] 四种失效模式：稻草人基线、绝对时间不跨机、饱和任务、基础设施缺陷假冒科学

quote: the measurements behind this loop are not trustworthy
note: [c-measurement] 「提议—测量—保留」这个循环背后的测量不可信

quote: against a naive baseline but 2.03
note: [c-measurement] 诚实基线把最好的 kernel 从 10.6 打到 2.03

quote: Only verified systems receive a score.
note: [c-measurement] ServerBench 侧的对应做法：未验证不计分

quote: we demonstrate that frontier models frequently engage in reward hacking to artificially inflate reported performance
note: [c-measurement] 前沿模型会系统性地 reward hacking 来抬高报告的性能

quote: models often exploit the narrow test distribution by hardcoding bypasses for specific tensor values
note: [c-reward-hacking] 利用窄测试分布：对特定张量值硬编码绕过

quote: enabling Tensor Core acceleration with TF32 provides a more realistic estimation of execution on modern GPUs
note: [c-reward-hacking] 基线本身要修：TF32 才是现代 GPU 的现实估计

quote: matching the PyTorch baseline in less than 20% of the cases
note: [c-reward-hacking] 起点基准的成绩：不到 20% 的用例能追平 PyTorch

quote: Optimization pressure induces reward hacking
note: [c-reward-hacking] 另一条线独立观察到：优化压力会诱发 reward hacking

quote: 24 have no test that checks a numerical result, and 13 of the 15 performance optimizations have no test that checks the promised saving
note: [c-test-prompt] 36 个 PR 里 24 个没有查数值的测试；15 个性能优化里 13 个没查所承诺的节省

quote: a patch that skips the optimization still passes
note: [c-test-prompt] 后果：跳过优化的补丁依然能过

quote: The prompts are underspecified.
note: [c-test-prompt] 另一侧：提示也没写清接口与行为，正确实现反而会失败

quote: We propose hidden-probe synthesis, implemented as an agent.
note: [c-test-prompt] 解法：隐藏探针合成——先写能过官方测试但违背未检查要求的对抗补丁，再为这些要求写新测试

quote: such approaches can be gamed to pass tests without capturing the actual intent of the code changes
note: [c-test-prompt] 另一条线同向：纯运行时指标可以被刷过测试而不体现改动意图

quote: Each agent receives a target LLM, one H100 GPU, an optimization scenario, and a wall-clock time budget of two hours.
note: [c-search-vs-agent] 设定干净：一块 H100、一个场景、两小时

quote: The performance gap to search reflects reliability and discipline failures, not a capability ceiling.
note: [c-search-vs-agent] 作者判断：差距来自可靠性与纪律，不是能力天花板

quote: Throughput exposes shallow optimization.
note: [c-search-vs-agent] 吞吐场景暴露浅层优化

quote: VibeServe uses an outer loop to plan and track the search over system designs, and an inner loop to implement candidates, check correctness, and measure performance on the target benchmark.
note: [c-search-vs-agent] 另一条解法：把搜索显式写成外层循环，而不是指望 agent 自发搜

quote: an agent harness that guides coding agents to lift simple developer-written reference implementations into optimized multi-GPU deployments
note: [c-search-vs-agent] 第三条解法：harness 引导，限制自由度换取可完成性

quote: agents with identical underlying models differ substantially, suggesting scaffolding is as important as the model
note: [c-harness] 同样的底座模型，脚手架差别显著——脚手架与模型同等重要

quote: we find no single agent dominates across codebases
note: [c-harness] 没有单一 agent 在所有代码库上占优

quote: Local Correctness Does Not Ensure Production Correctness
note: [c-harness] 仓库级任务上，本地正确也不保证生产正确

quote: Synthesizer agent, a harnessed coding agent, then lowers natural-language feature requests onto this abstraction
note: [c-harness] 连模拟器都要靠被打过 harness 的 agent 来写

quote: autonomously optimizes the entire mini-sglang engine without human intervention through iterative sessions with inherited experiences and code changes
note: [c-self-evolve] SEIS：无人干预、会话之间继承经验与代码改动，迭代优化整个引擎

quote: building on earlier sessions beats independent attempts
note: [c-self-evolve] 关键：在早前会话上继续，胜过各自独立的尝试——这是「递归」的经验证据

quote: The evaluation also has to evolve with the engine, and letting agents evolve it is a natural next step.
note: [c-self-evolve] 作者承认：评测也要跟着演化，而让 agent 去演化评测是「下一步」——即尚未做到

quote: agents plan experiments and revise their systems within a fixed development budget
note: [c-self-evolve] ServerBench 侧：在固定预算内计划实验并修订系统

quote: the first agentic loop that generates entire LLM serving stacks end-to-end
note: [c-self-evolve] VibeServe 自称第一条端到端生成整套服务栈的 agent 循环
